name: CI Runs page renders its no-installation empty state
description: From the app root, activates the CI Runs nav item (sidebar link, not a tab — no ?tab= whitelist involved here) and asserts on the no-installation empty-state copy. The hermetic seed imports repos/PRs/agents but installs no CI integration anywhere, so `GET /ci/runs` returns zero rows and the page — never having seen a Refresh response with `installations_checked > 0` — defaults to the more informative 'no installation anywhere' copy (client/insights.md would apply here if this were a component-level note; the distinction itself lives in CiRunsView's own module doc). That copy is unique to this page (CiTab's own empty state is different text), so this doubles as a reachability + empty-state check with read-only seeded data and no model call.

steps.label: activate the CI Runs sidebar nav item
the no-installation empty state renders — the hermetic seed has no CI installation
